title: RunDocument
description: cardiacFoam Run document v1. Every Run doc declares version: "1"; breaking schema changes bump version and add a migration step.

reports.description: Resolved per-run reports. Written by the workspace on the completed transition via resolveReports(run, catalog). See Spec §3, §5a.

physicsSlice.description: Physics-phase configuration as flat slot-keys (the post-$ELECTRO_MODEL_COEFFS slot_key form used by RunDocument.config). Nested OpenFOAM blocks are encoded as dot-separated leaf keys, e.g. 'ionicHeterogeneity.endoMInterface'. Only the most structured keys are described here; additional keys are permitted. The authoritative, complete key catalogue is the exported dict-catalog (openfoam_driver.dict_entries).

myocardiumSolver.description: Top-level myocardium solver selector (monodomainSolver | bidomainSolver | singleCellSolver | eikonalSolver). See the dict-catalog for the authoritative enum.

ionicModel.description: Ionic cell model selector. See the dict-catalog / ionic_model_catalog for the authoritative enum (includes compactBatched GPU variants).

tissue.description: Tissue selector for ionic-model specialisation. Must be one of the chosen ionicModel's compatible_tissues (enforced by validate_run).

ionicHeterogeneity.field.description: Name of the transmural-distance field (0=endo, 1=epi) that drives the heterogeneity blend.

ionicHeterogeneity.mode.description: Heterogeneity application mode. Only 'transmuralBands' is supported.

ionicHeterogeneity.endoMInterface.description: Normalized transmural position of the endo/M boundary, in (0, mEpiInterface). Solver default 0.3.

ionicHeterogeneity.mEpiInterface.description: Normalized transmural position of the M/epi boundary, in (endoMInterface, 1). Solver default 0.7.

ionicHeterogeneity.transitionWidth.description: Width of the smooth transition band; 0 selects hard transitions. Solver default 0.1.

ionicHeterogeneity.smoothing.description: Smoothing curve applied within transition bands.
